data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 11.1m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: release of GBP 6.2m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Increased notifications on the New Zealand earthquake claims have required strengthening of reserves on prior years.
Recognition of the Talisman claim, an emergence of a loss attaching to an historic Year of Account, has been required in the period.
The UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account has required some additional reserve strengthening on the older Years of Account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports adverse prior-year reserve movement, with an explicitly stated net deterioration of GBP 11.1m on prior year claims and management commentary describing strengthening of back year reserves (notably in relation to the New Zealand earthquake and specific historic claims such as the Talisman claim and UK Solicitors PI). The directors describe mixed current-year performance across divisions, but prior-year development is overall adverse and has driven reserve strengthening concentrated in Property and certain Professional Indemnity / Healthcare lines.

data.data_quality_notes: No gross aggregate 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure is disclosed in the notes; only a net deterioration (GBP 11.1m) is stated. A gross PYD figure could not be located in the disclosures or a claims development triangle; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. Opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2013) was taken from the balance sheet (explicit). Named events are taken from management narrative; many impacts are not quantified.
